newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,347 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,347 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1,347 contracts.
There were 37 wheat, 590 corn, 632 soybean, 38 soymeal and 50 soyoil futures contracts traded along with nine soybean call and 14 soybean put options.

Overnight, soybeans were 1/4 to one cent per bushel lower, wheat steady to one cent higher, one cent lower to 1/2 cent higher, soymeal unchanged to $0.40 per ton lower and soyoil 0.30 cent per lb higher to $0.50 lower.
